title: MCP: stage_get_bounds, stage_duplicate, stage_update schema enhancements
description:
Three MCP improvements. Files: agent-protocol/src/index.ts, authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts, vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts.

NOTE: Must be done AFTER task 1043 (which also touches these files).

1. stage_get_bounds: Add new MCP tool that returns bounding box of a display object.
   - Params: { id: string } — object id
   - Returns: { x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number }
   - Implementation: find the object across all scenes/layers/keyframes, compute bounds from its geometry (for shapes: iterate paths; for instances: use x/y/naturalWidth/naturalHeight)

2. stage_duplicate: Add new MCP tool to duplicate display objects on stage.
   - Params: { ids: string[], offsetX?: number, offsetY?: number } (default offset +10/+10)
   - Returns: { duplicatedIds: string[] }
   - Implementation: mirror the JSFL doc.duplicateSelection() — deep clone each target object, assign new id, insert at same layer/frame, offset by (offsetX, offsetY)

3. stage_update schema enhancements: Add explicit documented fields to StageUpdateParamsSchema:
   - blendMode: optional string (same enum as StagePlaceInstanceParamsSchema)
   - loopMode: optional string ('loop' | 'play-once' | 'single-frame')
   - firstFrame: optional number
   - colorEffect: optional object with type field
   These are already accepted by the handler (it passes updates straight to updateDisplayObject), but are undocumented in the schema. Adding them with .optional() makes them discoverable by MCP clients.

Run tests after (must stay at 612).
